h1: Mercedes Diesel Timing Chain & Injector Repair
lede: Expert workshop repair for OM-series diesel engines — timing chain replacement, injector seal renewal, and full system recalibration. Rebuilds start from £2,200.

blocks.html: Our workshop carries out full timing chain and injector seal repairs on all Mercedes OM-series diesel engines — including OM640, OM607, OM608, OM651, OM654, and OM642. The work is carried out to manufacturer specifications using genuine or OEM-quality parts, with full diagnostic calibration afterwards.

The complexity of the job varies by engine family. For example, the [OM654](/mercedes-om654-engine) has its timing chain mounted at the rear of the engine, which requires the engine to be removed from the vehicle for access. The [OM642](/mercedes-om642-engine) V6 allows for a “rolling” chain replacement method without removing the front timing cover, but any work on the chain guides still demands a full strip-down. Our technicians are trained in all these procedures and use the correct Mercedes-Benz locking and timing tools for every job.
All injector seal replacements are followed by IMA coding using XENTRY diagnostic software to ensure the engine management system recognises the new injector calibrations.

blocks.heading: Our Fixed-Price Rebuilds
paras: Price includes full disassembly, parts, labour, and final testing. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

blocks.html: We carry out timing chain and injector seal repairs on all Mercedes diesel models equipped with the following engine families. Select your model or engine below to see dedicated pages.

steps.title: Initial Assessment
steps.body: We inspect the engine and confirm the scope of work – whether timing chain, injector seals, or both. We lock the engine at TDC using factory tools.

steps.title: Engine Preparation
steps.body: For OM654, the engine is lifted out for rear-chain access. For front-chain designs (OM651, OM642), we remove the front ancillaries and timing cover.

steps.title: Chain Replacement
steps.body: Using the “rolling” method (OM642) or direct replacement, we install a new chain, tensioner, and guides. All components are torqued to specification.

steps.title: Injector Seals
steps.body: We remove each injector, clean the bore, fit new copper seals, and reinstall with correct torque. Seals are replaced during chain work where possible.

steps.title: Reassembly & Timing
steps.body: We reassemble all components, set final timing, and rivet the master link. The engine is manually turned to verify timing accuracy.

steps.title: Calibration & Testing
steps.body: Using XENTY, we perform IMA coding (if injectors changed) and run a full system test. The vehicle is road-tested to confirm repair quality.

sections.heading: How It Works – From Booking to Collection

steps.body: Call or [get a quote online](/contact) – we'll discuss your engine and arrange recovery if needed.
Vehicle arrives at our Essex workshop. We carry out a full inspection and confirm the repair scope.
We complete the repair (typically 3-5 working days for chain/injector work) and test thoroughly.
You collect your vehicle with a full report and 12-month warranty – or we arrange delivery.

items.q: How long does a timing chain or injector seal repair take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop. More complex jobs (e.g. OM654 rear-chain) may take slightly longer. We'll give you an estimated completion date when we start the work.

items.q: Do you use genuine Mercedes parts?
items.a: We use genuine Mercedes-Benz or OEM-quality parts (chains, tensioners, seals) to ensure reliability and compatibility with your engine.

items.q: Do I need to bring the car to you, or can you collect it?
items.a: We offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. Alternatively, you can drop it off at our Billericay workshop.

items.q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
items.a: Yes. All our timing chain and injector seal repairs come with a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty on parts and labour.

items.q: What is the price range for this repair?
items.a: For 4-cylinder diesel engines, rebuilds start from £2,200. For 6-cylinder V6 diesels (OM642), from £2,800. The final price depends on the exact engine and any additional parts needed.
